A first stop before [Classic Organs Compared](organ-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Farfisa is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **Farfisa Combo Compact** came out in **1964**; the Compact series was made until 1969 (Wikipedia, "Farfisa").
- Like the Vox it is a divide-down organ: twelve tone-generator boards and frequency dividers, with germanium transistors (Wikipedia).
- Its reverb tank is valve-driven, so it is not fully transistorised (Wikipedia).

## Its sound

- **Voice tabs**, each on or off: 16′ bass and strings; 8′ flute, oboe, trumpet and strings; 4′ flute, piccolo and strings (Wikipedia).
- No drawbars: a tab is either in or out, so levels come from which tabs you mix.
- **Four vibrato settings** (Wikipedia; here light / heavy and slow / fast, an UNVERIFIED reading).
- A **reverb** tab.

## The panel

This is the Farfisa panel from [Classic Organs Compared](organ-compare.qmd), drawn after the real one (not a copy). Play it from the keys under the panel or the computer keys (a w s e d f t g y h u j k); **Keys play** picks the manual. Pull a drawbar or press a tab while you play. The sound is this site's own model; nobody has compared it with the real instrument.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-box" data-kind="organ" data-id="farfisa"><div class="ocmp"></div></div>
```

## Guided tour

Each step loads a set of tabs and plays the same short phrase.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="far-flutes" data-set="{&quot;fl4&quot;:false,&quot;vib&quot;:&quot;off&quot;}"><p><b>Flute 8′ only.</b> Listen: a hollow, plain tone.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="far-flutes" data-set="{&quot;vib&quot;:&quot;off&quot;}"><p><b>Add Flute 4′.</b> Listen: brighter, an octave added.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="far-flutes"><p><b>Light fast vibrato.</b> Listen: the classic wobbly combo-organ sound.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="far-lobster"><p><b>Oboe and trumpet.</b> Reed tabs instead of flutes. Listen: buzzy and nasal.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="far-domine"><p><b>Heavy slow vibrato and reverb.</b> Listen: a wide, spacey sound.</p></div>
```

## Build it from a record

Each record below has a **Build it on the panel** button that loads a *starting* registration made on this page (not the player's documented setting), so you can listen to the record and change the panel by ear until it is close.

```{=html}
<div class="ocmp-tracks" data-organ="farfisa"></div>
```

## Famous records

Named in Wikipedia, "Farfisa":

- Sam the Sham and the Pharaohs, "Wooly Bully" (1965)
- Strawberry Alarm Clock, "Incense and Peppermints" (1967)
- Pink Floyd (Richard Wright started on a Combo Compact)
- Philip Glass, *Einstein on the Beach* (a Mini-Compact)
